newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares steady, Solidere's mixed in.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares steady, Solidere's mixed in.

text.p: Bank shares held steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday with Audi at $16 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce at $12.25.
Solidere A shares rose slightly to $10.625 from $10.5 on Tuesday while B shares held steady, for the third successive day this week, at $11.125.
Turnover in Audi, which began trading at $15 last week, rose to 44,861 shares from 20,500 while 5,500 BLC shares changed hands compared to 500 a day earlier.
Banque Audi and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce are the first two Lebanese banks listed on the BSE since it reopened in January 1996.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover rose to 125,754 shares from 97,694 and value was $1,602,997.75 against $1,157,769.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.42 percent to 918.55 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.13 percent to 81.70.
